description: This script fuses Google Mock and Google Test source code into combined header and source files, facilitating easier integration and distribution of Google Mock.

methods.name: GetGTestRootDir
methods.description: Returns the root directory of Google Test based on the gmock root directory.

methods.name: ValidateGMockRootDir
methods.description: Validates that the provided gmock root directory contains necessary files and directories.

methods.name: ValidateOutputDir
methods.description: Validates that the output directory is suitable for writing the generated files.

methods.name: FuseGMockH
methods.description: Generates a fused gmock.h header file by processing gmock source headers.

methods.name: FuseGMockAllCcToFile
methods.description: Fuses gmock-all.cc into a single output file, processing included headers.

methods.name: FuseGMockGTestAllCc
methods.description: Generates a combined gtest and gmock all-in-one cc file.

methods.name: FuseGMock
methods.description: Coordinates the fusion process for gtest and gmock source files.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point for the script, handling command-line arguments to trigger fusion process.
